goal: Install pysc2, download the Linux StarCraft II headless build (Blizzard s2client-proto downloads, ~4GB, extract to ~/StarCraftII or set SC2PATH) and the mini_games maps (pysc2 v1.2 release mini_games.zip) into the SC2 Maps dir. Then run `python -m pysc2.bin.agent --map CollectMineralShards --norender --max_episodes 1 --max_agent_steps 200` so the random agent plays and finishes without error, and make env.sh export SC2PATH if non-default.
check: The hidden test runs the random agent headless on the CollectMineralShards map for a short episode and checks it completes and reports a score.

agent.final: random agent played 200 steps on CollectMineralShards headless and exited cleanly. That needed a `protobuf<=3.20.3` pin, a one-line patch for an `extra_ports` bug in the latest pysc2 commit, a Python 3.11 venv and `unzip`. Two caveats: 200 steps ends before the game does, so the output shows step speed but no episode score line, and I didn't check whether the system Python 3.12 would have worked.
